terminals.name: cockpit-api
terminals.description: Rentemester cockpit backend API (bun run src/cli.ts serve) on http://127.0.0.1:4319, serving the $HOME/rentemester-workspace workspace with auth off for local dev.
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; export RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE="$HOME/rentemester-workspace"; export RENTEMESTER_APP_AUTH=off; mkdir -p "$RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE"; exec bun run src/cli.ts serve --workspace "$RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE" --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4319

terminals.name: cockpit-ui
terminals.description: Cockpit SPA Vite dev server on http://127.0.0.1:5319, proxying /api to the backend on port 4319.
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; cd app && exec bun run dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5319
